summary_en: SBINM LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of SBI Holdings, extended the tender offer period for BASE Inc. shares from September 30 to October 15, 2026 (30 business days total) at 340 yen per share. The settlement date was moved to October 22, 2026. Upon completion, SBINM will hold approximately 20.67% of BASE.
summary_jp: SBIホールディングス傘下のSBINM合同会社による公開買付けの買付期間が9月30日から10月15日に延長され、30営業日となった。買付価格は1株340円据え置き、決済開始日は10月22日に変更。完了後の議決権割合は20.67%。

key_facts.reason_jp: 持分法適用関連会社化

summary_en: Tender offer by SBINM LLC (wholly-owned subsidiary of SBI Holdings) to acquire up to 23.8M shares at ¥340/share (20.67% of voting rights) during Aug 31–Sep 30, 2026 (extendable to Oct 15). Purpose: associate company under equity method. Board supports offer; shareholders' decision on participation is neutral. Listing on TSE Growth market will be maintained post-offer. Concurrent capital and business partnership agreement with SBI Holdings.
summary_jp: SBI Holdings完全子会社SBINM合同会社による公開買付け。上限2,379.2万株、340円/株、議決権ベース20.67%。期間：2026年8月31日～9月30日（延長可能）。目的：持分法適用関連会社化。取締役会は賛同、株主の応募判断は中立。上場維持予定。SBI Holdingsとの資本業務提携契約を同時締結。
